title: Bittersweet Pilaf with Vegetables
description: A flavorful and healthy pilaf dish made with bittersweet ingredients and mixed vegetables.

ingredients.name: vegetables
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of bell peppers, carrots, and onions

ingredients.name: vegetables
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of zucchini, tomatoes, and mushrooms

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the bittersweet ingredients and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the pilaf and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
